body:
| Name | Reason |
|---|---|
| Acutaas Chemicals | ₹32k cr at a P/E of 73.5. The reverse DCF implies about 31% EPS CAGR for 10 years, so it is priced for perfection. |
| Neuland Labs | ₹27k cr at a P/E of 60. Quarters are lumpy (OPM swings between 12% and 40%), so the trend is not sustained. |
| Sansera Engineering | ₹29.6k cr at a P/E of 72 with ROCE of about 15%. Too expensive. |
| Happy Forgings | High quality (31% OPM), but a P/E of 49 at ₹17k cr already prices that in. DIIs are trimming (17.1% → 14.9%). |
| Shivalik Bimetal | Best growth in the set (Q2 sales +45% YoY). But a P/E of 47 implies about 25% CAGR. DIIs cut from 21.1% to 10.9% in two quarters, and debtor days rose to 99. **Watchlist.** |
| Caplin Point | Debtor days have risen every year, from 12 to 138. Receivables are LatAm-heavy. |
| Marksans Pharma | Near-miss: P/E 24, ROCE 19%. But the cash conversion cycle has stretched to 261 days, borrowings went from 30 to 465, and FII holding swings (8% → 19%). |
| eClerx | Near-miss on quality (ROCE 34%, P/E 19). But debtor days went from 62 to 90, FIIs are trimming, and it carries IT/AI de-rating risk. |
| Banco Products | **Closest alternate.** P/E 19.4, ROCE 31%, consolidated Q2 profit +19% YoY. But the standalone (India) profit is falling and growth leans on the NRF Europe arm. Borrowings are ₹516 cr and the CCC is 232. Price verified at ₹704.5 (Google) / ₹706.5 (Screener). **Watchlist.** |
| Avanti Feeds | OPM collapsed from 13% to 4.5% in two quarters, a shrimp margin shock. |
| Apex Frozen | ROCE about 10% and Q2 OPM of 4.9%. |
| Supriya Lifescience | OPM fell from 36% to 22% in the last two quarters, and debtor days went from 70 to 97. |
| Aarti Pharmalabs | ROCE about 11%. Borrowings went from 338 to 897 and promoter holding slipped from 44.65% to 39.66%. |
| Hikal | Loss-making in 4 of the last 6 quarters, with ROCE of 3.5%. |
| Vishnu Chemicals | Borrowings doubled (342 → 718), so growth is debt-funded. ROCE is fading (30% → 16%). |
| Fineotex | FY26 CFO was −24 against PAT of 125, and debtor days reached 137 (acquisition-driven). |
| Privi Speciality | About ₹1,000 cr of debt. Promoter holding fell from 74% to 60.6% (stake sale), and P/E is 37. |
| Indo Count | ROCE 8%, debt ₹1,314 cr, P/E 47. |
| Pearl Global | Borrowings went from 463 to 1,218, OPM is about 10%, promoter holding is slipping, and P/E is 35. |
| Gokaldas Exports | ROCE 7.7%. FIIs halved (26.5% → 13.4%) and debt is ₹1,101 cr. |
| GNA Axles | Promoter holding fell from 68.4% to 58.5% in two quarters. Debtor days are 151 and ROCE is 14%. |
| Sharda Motor | A domestic business, not an exporter. OPM is sliding (14% → 10%). |
| Frontier Springs | Domestic railways, outside the theme. |
| Mastek | Cheap at a P/E of about 10.6, but OPM slid from 17% to 14% and FIIs fell from 11.2% to 5.9%. Exposed to the UK public sector. **Contrarian watch.** |
| R Systems | P/E of about 13, with acquisition-led growth of about 30%. DIIs went from 9.4% to 4.65%, and there is a Blackstone overhang. **Contrarian watch.** |
| Saksoft / Nucleus / Sasken | Revenue flat for six quarters / OPM collapsed to 4–7% / CFO negative for two years. |
title: theme_weak_rupee_exporters › Rejected (one line each)
